fields.description: A project's own key replaces this where it has one — `onetask/task.py`. Linear's ENG-14 is the thing people actually say to each other.
fields.label: Series

fields.description: What there is to do, in the words somebody would say.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: Which column it is in. A Link and not a Select, which is the whole of "each board has its own columns".
fields.label: State

fields.description: The state's own category, copied here on save. Derived and not a second truth: the engine's badge, its filters and "is it finished" all want a Select, and a Link cannot be one. `onetask/task.py` keeps it.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: The board it is on, where it is on one. Empty is the inbox: a task nobody has placed yet.
fields.label: Project

fields.description: A task under another. Not a checklist — see `One Task Step`.
fields.label: Parent

fields.description: Who is carrying it. Written from the assignment and not instead of it: `assign_to.add` keeps the ToDo that puts it in their own list, and this is what a board groups and filters by without reading JSON.
fields.label: Owner

fields.description: How long somebody thinks it will take. Minutes because every other unit is a fight about half days.
fields.label: Estimate (minutes)

fields.description: Rolled up from the time logged against it.
fields.label: Spent (minutes)

fields.description: Where it sits in its column, as a string that sorts. Fractional — `a0`, `a0V`, `a1` — so dragging one card rewrites one row rather than the whole column. On the record and not in the reader's own arrangement: a project's order is the team's.
fields.label: Rank

fields.description: A date the project is measured by rather than a piece of work. Drawn as a diamond on the plan.
fields.label: Milestone
